scope: Assessment evidence logic; excludes nutrition expansion

findings.issue: Positive limited-supplement verdict is inferred despite specialist avoid-feeding guidance; cited chemistry paper is not affirmative tortoise-feeding evidence.
findings.action: Review grade and published rationale together; distinguish non-recommended fruit from proven acute toxicity.

findings.issue: Assessment relies on limited-feeding specialist guidance and a leaf-extract paper; extract cytotoxicity does not establish safety of fresh leaves in tortoises.
findings.action: Verify specialist plant-part recommendation and keep extract findings explicitly non-clinical.

findings.issue: Genus-level Acer spp. guidance may not transfer safely to each species; current assessment recognizes this uncertainty.
findings.action: Check species identity and known species-specific hazards before promoting individual species.

findings.issue: Leaves/flowers and tubers are correctly distinguished in the existing assessment; mammalian effects are not direct tortoise evidence.
findings.action: Maintain part-specific caveat; check that all public cards preserve it.

policy: Audit flags are not evidence of toxicity; do not alter public grades without primary-source review.

followup_20261009.bellpepper_evidence_gap: Chemical composition paper cannot by itself establish a positive feeding recommendation against specialist avoid-feeding advice.
followup_20261009.next_review_gate: Do not change public feeding verdict before source-by-source review of directness and species/plant-part applicability.
